title: 5 key benefits of a clinical communication and collaboration platform
summary: How can today’s clinical communication and collaboration (CC&C) platforms help all staff communicate better and focus on the job of patient care?
body_markdown:
- Healthcare spending is climbing toward 20.3% of GDP by 2033 while clinician burnout surged 89% year-over-year, driven largely by technology-driven workload.
- Fragmented communication systems drain IT resources and staff efficiency; consolidated CC&C platforms reduce operational friction and improve patient outcomes.
- This eBook explores five concrete benefits of clinical communication platforms and the measurable results they generate for hospitals.


Healthcare in the United States continues to face significant financial and operational pressures. According to[CMS National Health Expenditure data](https://www.cms.gov/data-research/statistics-trends-and-reports/national-health-expenditure-data/historical) , U.S. healthcare spending reached $5.3 trillion in 2024 (or $15,474 per person) and accounted for 18.0% of GDP. Looking ahead,[CMS projects](https://www.healthsystemtracker.org/chart-collection/how-much-is-health-spending-expected-to-grow/) health spending will grow to 20.3% of GDP by 2033. Meanwhile, the[Peterson-KFF Health System Tracker](https://www.healthsystemtracker.org/chart-collection/health-spending-u-s-compare-countries/) reports that per-capita U.S. healthcare spending in 2024 reached $14,775—nearly twice the average of comparable wealthy nations.


But costs aren’t the only issue. Staffing shortages, clinician burnout, inefficient workflows, and fragmented technology continue to strain hospitals. The[Medscape Physician Burnout & Depression Report 2024](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/new-medscape-report-reveals-progress-among-physician-burnout-depression-302043454.html) found 49% of physicians report burnout, with the latest[Spok State of Healthcare Communications report](https://www.spok.com/blog/state-of-healthcare-communications/) showing burnout increased 89% year-over-year.


Fortunately, healthcare leaders are actively reassessing their processes, infrastructure, and technology strategies to improve care and reduce costs. Read this eBook to learn how clinical communication and collaboration (CC&C) platforms streamline workflows and help staff communicate better and focus on patient care.


[I’m ready to read!](https://resources.spok.com/benefits-clinical-communication-platform)


**In this eBook, you’ll learn:**


- The technology landscape driving digital transformation in healthcare
- The five benefits of a clinical communication platform
- The results a clinical communication platform can generate
